arxiv-1502-00489.title: Carbon-dioxide-like Skyrmion controlled by spin-orbit coupling in atomic-molecular Bose-Einstein condensates
arxiv-1502-00489.creator: Chao-Fei Liu 1,2, Gediminas Juzeliūnas 3, and Wu-Ming Liu 1⋆
arxiv-1502-00489.description: Abstract Atomic-molecular Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs) offer brand new opportunities to revolutionize quantum gases and probe the variation of fundamental constants with unprecedented sensitivity. The recent realization of spin-orbit coupling (SOC) in BECs provides a new platform for exploring completely new phenomena unrealizable elsewhere. However, there is no study of SOC atomic-molecular BECs so far.

arxiv-1807-04593.title: The Deformation Quantization of the Scalar Fields
arxiv-1807-04593.creator: Jie Wu, Mai Zhou
arxiv-1807-04593.description: Abstract In this paper the deformation quantization is constructed in the case of scalar fields on Minkowski space-time based on the equal time Poisson brackets. We construct the star products at three levels concerning fields, Hamiltonian functionals and their underlying structure called Hamiltonian functions in a special sense.

arxiv-2204-08180.title: A Taxonomy of Error Sources in HPC I/O Machine Learning Models
arxiv-2204-08180.creator: Mihailo Isakov 1 , Mikaela Currier 1 , Eliakin del Rosario 1 , Sandeep Madireddy 2 , Prasanna Balaprakash 2 , Philip Carns 2 , Robert B. Ross 2 , Glenn K. Lockwood 3 , Michel A. Kinsy 1
arxiv-2204-08180.description: Abstract I/O efficiency is crucial to productivity in scientific computing, but the increasing complexity of the system and the applications makes it difficult for practitioners to understand and optimize I/O behavior at scale. Data-driven machine learning-based I/O throughput models offer a solution: they can be used to identify bottlenecks, automate I/O tuning, or optimize job scheduling with minimal human intervention.

arxiv-2206-00313.title: High-Order Large-Eddy Simulations of a Wind Turbine in Ducted and Open-Rotor Configurations
arxiv-2206-00313.creator: Chi Ding, Bin Zhang, Chunlei Liang, Kenneth Visser, Guangming Yao
arxiv-2206-00313.description: Abstract High-order large-eddy simulations are performed to study the performance and flow field of a ducted wind turbine operating at different tip speed ratios. To evaluate the effects of the duct, simulations with the same tip speed ratios are also performed on the corresponding open-rotor turbine.

arxiv-2206-05039.title: Image Generation with Multi-modal Priors using Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic models Thanks: Work in Progress
arxiv-2206-05039.creator: Nithin Gopalakrishnan Nair, Wele Gedara Chaminda Bandara, Vishal M Patel
arxiv-2206-05039.description: Abstract Image synthesis under multi-modal priors is a useful and challenging task that has received increasing attention in recent years. A major challenge in using generative models to accomplish this task is the lack of paired data containing all modalities (i.e. priors) and corresponding outputs.

arxiv-2302-06390.title: Neutrino mixing angle and neutrino oscillation in ALPs matter
arxiv-2302-06390.creator: Alexey Lichkunov, Alexander Studenikin
arxiv-2302-06390.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alexey Lichkunov, Alexander Studenikin. Axions and axion-like particles (ALPs) are among of the most popular candidates for dark matter. Axions are also considered as new physics contributions to the muon g – 2 . Following the existed interest to ALPs we consider interaction between neutrinos and hypothetical axion-like particles and derive for the first time the probability of neutrino oscillations accounting for their interactions mediated by ALPs. The corresponding effective mixing angle is derived.

The Xe spin polarization is sensed by an in-situ Rb-magnetometer.

arxiv-2308-07759.title: Electronic and optical properties of boron containing GaN alloys: The role boron atom clustering
arxiv-2308-07759.creator: Cara-Lena Nies, Thomas Sheerin, Stefan Schulz
arxiv-2308-07759.description: Abstract Boron (B) containing III-nitride materials, such as wurtzite (B,Ga)N alloys, have recently attracted significant interest to tailor the electronic and optical properties of optoelectronic devices operating in the visible and ultraviolet spectral range. However, the growth of high quality samples is challenging and B atom clustering is often observed in (B,Ga)N alloys.

arxiv-2405-11637.title: Zero-Shot Stance Detection using Contextual Data Generation with LLMs
arxiv-2405-11637.creator: Ghazaleh Mahmoudi, Babak Behkamkia, Sauleh Eetemadi
arxiv-2405-11637.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ghazaleh Mahmoudi, Babak Behkamkia, Sauleh Eetemadi. Stance detection, the classification of attitudes expressed in a text towards a specific topic, is vital for applications like fake news detection and opinion mining. However, the scarcity of labeled data remains a challenge for this task. To address this problem, we propose Dy namic Mo del Adap tation with Contextual Data Generation (DyMoAdapt) that combines Few-Shot Learning and Large Language Models. In this approach, we aim to fine-tune an existing model at test time.

pmc-12964619.creator: Chi-Hsien Huang, I-Hui Chiang, I-Cheng Lu, Po-Hsuan Lai, Pei-Lun Liao, Jing-Yang Huang, Ming-Ta Hsieh, Chi-Wei Lin, I-Ting Liu, James Cheng-Chung Wei
